text:
shreya: :rotating_light: alert from observability — sudden p99 spike on streaming API (route /v1/stream) starting ~1749876520. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 850ms, p99 to ~3.2s. Also saw streaming stalls and partial responses.

dana: seeing same in dashboards. top affected clusters: inference-us-west-2-a, inference-us-west-2-b. Error rates stable but tail latency and partial chunking out.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-1749876543. Paging shreya, dana, kevin. Runbooks: streaming-tail-latency.

kevin: grabbing oncall. I'm looking at cache telemetry — global prefix cache hitrate dropped from 86% -> 22% at 17:54:xx. KV prefetch queue depth spiked. suspect recent prefix-hash rollout (rolled earlier today) caused namespace salt mismatch on some shard groups.

leo: adding logs — found repeated fetch misses for keys like "pref:namespace:0x7f3a..." and an uptick in backend read latency (redis-mem replica). Prefetch workers started backoff loops.

shreya: @kevin can you confirm whether the hash salt was toggled in config push at 1749860000? I remember a gradual rollout.

kevin: yes, rollout of prefix-hash v2 started ~1749859000 with canary then expansion. Looks like ~30% of shards got v2 earlier, then a config flip expanded to 100% at 1749876200 (too close to spike). The new hash changed key distribution, causing coldness and evictions.

dana: customer impact — CS dashboard shows rise in degraded streaming sessions (session partials) for customers: Acme Games (session ids attached), QuickForms (high call volume). Not yet SLA-breach pages but trending. I'll notify CS to prepare comms if we hit sustained p99 > 2s for 15m.

oncall-bot: current SLO status: streaming latency SLO (p99 < 2s) is breached.

kevin: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause prefix-hash rollout 2) revert salt to previous value on affected shards 3) warm the cache (parallel background prefetch) 4) temporary increase cache size/ttl on replicas 5) route high-priority customer traffic to fallback legacy routing via feature-flag.

shreya: agreed. Who can run the rollback? kevin volunteered earlier.

kevin: executing rollback now. Command: ```bash
./infractl rollout undo prefix-hash-roller --to-revision=rev-2024-11-07 --namespace=inference
``` Applying to clusters us-west-2-a,b. Patching now.

infra-bot: deploy job started: rollout-undo/prefix-hash-roller -> job id job-77431. ETA ~90s.

leo: meanwhile enabling prefetch warmers: ```json
{"task":"batch_prefetch","namespaces":["highq","nlp","chat"],"parallelism":8}
``` launching via prefetcher service.

dana: CS notified key customers with potential degradation. Marking Acme Games as high-risk and enabling fallback routing for them.

shreya: monitoring: cache hit rate trending up from 22% -> 58% in us-west-2-a after rollback started. p95 back down to ~180ms. p99 dropping but still at ~1.6s.

oncall-bot: job job-77431 succeeded (1749876635). Rollback complete. Please confirm smoke tests.

kevin: running smoke: ``curl -s -D - -o /dev/null "https://inference-us-west-2-a.internal/v1/stream?test=tail" -H 'Authorization: Bearer test'`` responses now streaming full chunks within p95 latency. No more prefetch backoffs in logs.

leo: cache warmers finished pass 1; prefetch queue cleared. Hitrate ~74% now.

dana: CS update: degraded sessions reduced by 90% after rollback. Still seeing a small cohort with stalls due to client-side replaying — we've queued a client-retry guidance note.

shreya: follow-up actions before handoff: 1) add canary gating to rollout that validates hitrate delta < 5% 2) increase rollout wait windows & auto-rollback trigger on hitrate drop 3) create playbook for warming after prefix changes 4) run postmortem and tag customers impacted.

kevin: opened an RFC ticket RF-3254 to change rollout pipeline and add automatic hitrate checks. Also logging a remediation script to rekey stale prefixes if needed.

shreya: preparing handoff to next oncall (dana ending shift). Dana, can you take watch and continue monitoring p99 for 30m? If p99 > 2s for 10m, escalate to eng-runtime.

dana: taking handoff. I'll leave runbook notes in the incident doc. Current status: rollback complete, hitrate stabilizing ~78%, p95 140ms, p99 920ms. Customer impact reduced. Running 30m watch.

customer-success: thanks for the quick mitigation. We'll open followups for the two customers affected and request postmortem summary to share.

shreya: adding retrospective owner: kevin. ETA for postmortem draft: 48h. Add links to logs, rollout diffs, and the prefetch warm-up metrics in the doc.

oncall-bot: incident INC-1749876543 status -> mitigated (watching). Handed off to dana for monitoring. Add tags: prefix-hash, cache-miss, rollback, streaming-latency.

shreya: closing note: prioritize automated test for prefix-hash compatibility in staging; manual rollouts are too error prone.

kevin: noted. I'll include the canary gating change in RF-3254 and schedule a deploy of the gating in next sprint.

dana: (reaction :thumbsup:) monitoring continues. If anything flares I'll re-open the incident thread.

leo: leaving logs and a short grep snippet in the incident doc: ```bash
grep "prefetch miss" /var/log/prefetcher/* | head -n 200
```

shreya: thanks team. :white_check_mark:
